summary.text: Seth Bronko was first elected in 2022 as the State Representative for the 70th House District and is Ranking Member of the Higher Education and Employment Advancement Committee.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Naugatuck, he graduated from the University of Connecticut with a B.S. in Business Management-Entrepreneurship and a minor in Communications.

He co-founded Bronko Construction with his father, became a licensed real estate agent in 2020, and has served on boards including the Naugatuck Finance Board and the Naugatuck Economic Development Corporation.
